payload.text:
📖 Writer's Muse — your writing companion

Tap /start to open the menu, then pick what you want from the buttons.

• 💡 Get idea — writing prompts for any genre
• 🎵 Check rhythm — analyze meter and rhyme
• ✨ Improve rhyme — get suggestions for your text
• 📝 Request review — send your work for human feedback
